firstPlay.name: No Fill
firstPlay.why: No SKU cleared wave-over or Fill. Perfect Order box is flow (29/day), not a floor watch.

rules.stillCutting: not a floor. Do not call bottom.
rules.waveOver: copies dried after a climax/higher-low/listings left = Watch the floor, even if the set can still be printed
fillRequires: price within 8% of the low for 8+ days
rules.forceLock: Tyler does not lock a play unless the prompt starts with FORCE:

plays.name: Destined Rivals Booster Box
plays.why: Printed 3m low $244.99 vs the 09-29 print of $361.99. That is a cut, not a held low. Market $365.82 is ~49% above it. 934 copies / 10 a day — not dried. Wait is the cut, not the print clock. History tape 403, so the $244.99 print is not a confirmed 30-day low.
plays.watchTurnsFillIf: Set leaves play, the $244.99 low stops cutting and holds 8+ days, solds exhaust, market within 8% of that low.
